name: Alabama
agency: Alabama Alcoholic Beverage Control Board (ABC Board)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Retail license types include lounge retail liquor (Class I), restaurant retail liquor, club liquor, and on-premise beer/wine; filter the search by Type. Exact type codes not confirmed in results.
licence_data.terms_notes: Search tool filters by name, license number, type, issued date and county; no bulk download seen. Bulk list via public records request (fee depends on scope).

local_control: State ABC Board issues licenses; cities/counties must approve applications (local consent) and some issue their own local licenses. Wet/dry status set locally.
alternatives: Public records request to ABC Board (abc--openrecords@abc.alabama.gov) for full retail licensee list
County health department restaurant inspection data
Scrape licensesearch.alabama.gov/AOWB by county and type
manual_steps: Submit public records request at https://alabcboard.gov/public-records-request asking for all active on-premise retail licenses (CSV/XLSX) with addresses
Or scrape licensesearch.alabama.gov/AOWB county by county
notes: Control state (ABC Board runs state liquor stores). Many dry or partially dry counties with wet municipalities; licenses cluster in wet cities.

sources.title: Public Records Request | Alabama ABC Board

name: Alaska
agency: Alcohol & Marijuana Control Office (AMCO), Alcoholic Beverage Control Board, Dept. of Commerce, Community & Economic Development

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Beverage Dispensary (bars/lounges, beer-wine-spirits on premises; ~399 licenses), Restaurant or Eating Place (beer & wine), Club, Brewery/Winery/Distillery (limited on-site). Filter by license type in AK-ACCIS public search.
licence_data.terms_notes: AK-ACCIS public License and Permit Search (live Sept 2023); AMCO warns not all data may be current after migration. No bulk download URL seen; the AMCO homepage also links a 'Licenses and Applications by Status' list (URL not captured).

local_control: State issues licenses; local governing bodies (boroughs/municipalities, e.g. Municipality of Anchorage) can protest. Many communities have local option (damp/dry) restrictions.
alternatives: Request full license list from AMCO (alcohol.licensing@alaska.gov, 907-269-0350)
Municipality of Anchorage clerk licensing records
Scrape AK-ACCIS public search
manual_steps: Use AK-ACCIS public license search and export/scrape Beverage Dispensary and Restaurant/Eating Place licenses, or email AMCO for a full active license export
notes: Over 100 local-option (dry/damp) communities, mostly rural; population-based license limits. Small total volume (~a few thousand licenses) so a one-time request is practical.

sources.title: Alaska Releases Online Portal for Alcohol Licenses and Permits (Holland & Knight)

name: Arizona
agency: Arizona Department of Liquor Licenses and Control (DLLC)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Series 6 = Bar (all spirits, on/off premises); Series 7 = Beer & Wine Bar; Series 12 = Restaurant (40%+ food); Series 11 = Hotel/Motel; Series 14 = Private Club; Series 3/13/18 = microbrewery/farm winery/craft distillery.
licence_data.terms_notes: Database lookup page filters by status, type, county, city; export capability not confirmed. Public records request page available.

local_control: State issues licenses; city/county governing body gives recommendation on applications.
alternatives: Public records request for all active Series 6/7/11/12/14 licenses via https://liquor.az.gov/public-records-request
Maricopa County environmental services food permits
Scrape license-search by type + county
manual_steps: Run license-search filtered by type (06, 07, 12, 11, 14) and status Active; export/scrape results, or submit a public records request for a CSV of active licenses
notes: Old ColdFusion azliquor.gov query pages (license_recordcount.cfm) still indexed; may offer query results. Tribal lands may have separate licensing.

sources.title: License Search | Department of Liquor Licenses & Control

name: Arkansas
agency: Arkansas Alcoholic Beverage Control Division (ABC), Dept. of Finance and Administration

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Permit types include Restaurant Mixed Drink (maximum/beer & wine), Private Club Class A (wet county / dry county), On-Premises Beer/Wine. Weekly and monthly PDFs list applicant, business name, address, county, permit type.
licence_data.terms_notes: Only change lists (weekly applications, monthly permit changes) published as PDFs; no full active-permit roster or search found.

local_control: State issues permits; wet/dry status by county/city local option election.
alternatives: Arkansas FOIA request to ABC (abcadmin@dfa.arkansas.gov, 501-682-1105) for full active permit list
Arkansas Dept of Health restaurant inspection data
Build incrementally from weekly/monthly PDFs
manual_steps: Send Arkansas FOIA request to ABC for all active retail on-premise permits (Excel)
Optionally parse monthly Permit Change List PDFs to keep it current
notes: Many dry counties; private clubs (Class A dry county) serve alcohol there. Act 762 of 2025 removed nonprofit requirement for private clubs.

name: California
agency: California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Type 41 = On-Sale Beer & Wine Eating Place; Type 47 = On-Sale General Eating Place; Type 48 = On-Sale General Public Premises (bar); Type 40 = On-Sale Beer (tavern); Type 42 = On-Sale Beer & Wine Public Premises; Type 51/52 = clubs; Type 75 = brewpub.
licence_data.terms_notes: Licensing Reports page offers daily/weekly/monthly reports and a raw data download of all pending and active licenses; exact file URL/format not seen in results (assumed CSV/text - verify).

local_control: State ABC issues all licenses; cities/counties handle zoning/conditional use permits only.
alternatives: Licenses by County/City/Zip reports on abc.ca.gov
County environmental health restaurant inspection open data (LA County, SF, San Diego)
SDRDL mirror of ABC licenses (data.sandiegodata.org)
manual_steps: Confirm raw data download URL on Licensing Reports page, then schedule download and filter to types 40,41,42,47,48,51,52,75
notes: Largest state (~90k+ retail licenses est.). Data not geocoded; census tract available in some reports.

ABCA Weekly Issuance report
Alcohol License Cancellations dataset

name: Florida
agency: Florida DBPR Division of Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco (ABT)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Series/type codes: 4COP (quota, all liquor on-premises), 4COP-SRX (restaurant), 2COP (beer & wine on-premises), 1COP (beer on-premises), 11C/ clubs; see license_types.pdf and Public Records Layout for column meanings.
licence_data.terms_notes: Licensee download CSV files (by district) updated every morning; review ReadMe/Disclaimer. Daily activity extract seen at https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/sto/file_download/extracts/daily.csv. Per-district file URLs not captured.

County health inspection data

Request lists from Kauai and Hawaii County liquor departments
